body.description: a small cozy cottage house with a green vine-covered roof, in the art style of a classic Pokemon Diamond Pearl Platinum overworld town building, clean simple flat cel-shaded pixel art with bold dark outlines, the roof viewed from a high top-down angle filling the upper part of the sprite with a short front wall and door at the bottom, NO side walls visible, bright limited color palette, low detail cute simple shapes, original design, top-down RPG map building tile, transparent background
